title: diphasiastrum complanatum subsp. issleri
intro: Diphasiastrum complanatum subsp. issleri, commonly known as Issler's forked spike moss, is a species of bryophyte in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the ancient group of lycopods, characterized by its forked and branching stems. Issler's forked spike moss has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and boosting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
